# Troubleshooting Workflow Governance

## Trigger
Apply this workflow when user asks to fix, debug, investigate, or troubleshoot issues.

## Required Process
1. Create troubleshooting plan first.
2. Create `artifacts/YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS-short-description/`.
3. Create one iteration file per step (`iteration-001-analysis.md`, etc.).
4. Document inspected items, changes, rationale, tests, results, and next step.
5. Stop after each iteration and wait for user approval.

## Prohibitions
- Do not continue to additional troubleshooting iterations without explicit user approval.
